CHAPTER.VERS: Be not thou envious against evil men, neither desire to be with them.
For their heart studieth destruction, and their lips talk of mischief.
Through wisdom is an house built; and by understanding it is established:
And by knowledge shall the chambers be filled with all precious and pleasant riches.

A wise man strong; and a man of knowledge increaseth strength.
is strong: Heb. is in strength
increaseth…: Heb. strengtheneth might
For by wise counsel thou shalt make thy war: and in multitude of counsellors safety.
Wisdom too high for a fool: he openeth not his mouth in the gate.
He that deviseth to do evil shall be called a mischievous person.
The thought of foolishness sin: and the scorner an abomination to men.

thou faintest in the day of adversity, thy strength small.
small: Heb. narrow
If thou refraineth to deliver drawn to death, and ready to be slain;
If thou sayest, Behold, we knew it not; doth not he that weigheth the heart consider ? and he that keepeth thy soul, doth he know ? and shall he render to man according to his works?

My son, eat thou honey, because good; and the honeycomb, sweet to thy taste:
to…: Heb. upon thy palate
So the knowledge of wisdom to thy soul: when thou hast found , then there shall be a reward, and thy expectation shall not be cut off.
Lay not wait, O wicked , against the dwelling of the righteous; destroy not his resting place:
For a just falleth seven times, and riseth again: but the wicked shall fall into mischief.
Rejoice not when thy enemy falleth, and let not thy heart be glad when he stumbleth:

Lest the LORD see , and it displease him, and he turn away his wrath from him.
it displease…: Heb. it be evil in his eyes

Fret not thyself because of evil , neither be thou envious at the wicked;
Fret…: or, Keep not company with the wicked

For there shall be no reward to the evil ; the lamp of the wicked shall be put out.
candle: or, lamp

My son, fear thou the LORD and the king: meddle not with them that are given to change:
them…: Heb. changers
For their calamity shall rise suddenly; and who knoweth the ruin of them both?
These also to the wise. not good to have respect of persons in judgment.
He that saith to the wicked, Thou righteous; him shall the people curse, nations shall abhor him:

But to them that rebuke shall be delight, and a good blessing shall come upon them.
a good…: Heb. a blessing of good

shall kiss lips that giveth a right answer.
that…: Heb. that answereth right words
Prepare thy work outside, and make it fit for thyself in the field; and afterwards build thy house.
Be not a witness against thy neighbour without cause; and deceive with thy lips.
Say not, I will do so to him as he hath done to me: I will render to the man according to his work.
I went by the field of the slothful, and by the vineyard of the man void of understanding;
And, lo, it was all grown over with thorns, nettles had covered the face of it, and its stone wall was broken down.

Then I saw, considered well: I looked upon received instruction.
considered…: Heb. set my heart
a little sleep, a little slumber, a little folding of the hands to sleep:

So shall thy poverty come one that travelleth; and thy want as an armed man.
an…: Heb. a man of shield
